experiments.label: E4-config-readonly
args:
set -eu
for p in /config/models.json /config/settings.json /config/auth.json; do
 if (echo synthetic > "$p") 2>/dev/null; then exit 1; fi
done
if rm /config/settings.json 2>/dev/null; then exit 1; fi
if ln -sf /workspace/replacement /config/models.json 2>/dev/null; then exit 1; fi
echo CONFIG_PROTECTED

experiments.label: D1-D2-E3-pi-synthetic
args:
set -eu
mkdir -p /workspace/home /workspace/tmp
/runtime/node /bridge.mjs > /workspace/bridge-ready 2>/workspace/bridge-error &
bridge=$!
trap 'kill "$bridge" 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
i=0
while ! grep -q BRIDGE_READY /workspace/bridge-ready; do
 i=$((i+1)); test "$i" -lt 100; sleep 0.02
done
"$@"
Responda somente ao teste sintético local.
